rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for goods offered for sale.

example.english: This shop has a wide range of merchandise.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅貨品款式好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 fo3 ban2 fun2 sik1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for branded merchandise connected with a team, band, company, or fictional work.

example.english: I bought some new merchandise from that band.
example.traditional: 我買咗嗰隊樂隊新出嘅周邊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go2 deoi6 ngok6 deoi2 san1 ceot1 ge3 zau1 bin1
